summary_en: Interim dividend increased by 4 yen to 41 yen per share effective November 9, 2026. Full-year dividend forecast revised upward by 4 yen to 82 yen per share, with year-end dividend raised to 41 yen per share from prior guidance of 37 yen.
title_en: Notice on Interim Dividend Increase and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast for the Fiscal Year Ending February 2027
translation_en_brief:
Nakamoto Packs announced increases to both interim and year-end dividends for fiscal year ending February 2027. The interim dividend (record date August 31, 2026; effective date November 9, 2026) was raised by 4 yen to 41 yen per share from the prior forecast of 37 yen. The year-end dividend forecast was simultaneously revised upward by 4 yen to 41 yen per share, also from 37 yen guidance. As a result, the full-year dividend forecast was increased by 8 yen to 82 yen per share, compared to prior guidance of 74 yen per share.

The company cited its basic dividend policy of returning profits to shareholders while strengthening financial position through revenue-focused operations. The dividend increases reflect revised second-quarter and full-year earnings forecasts announced on the same date. The interim dividend totaling 365 million yen is payable from retained earnings.
